passive.name: Hatching Day
passive.text: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by **90/99/108/117/126**. When Anomaly DMG dealt by any squad member to an enemy triggers a critical hit, the equipper's **Fire DMG** increases by **40/44/48/52/56%** for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Energetic Strike
passive.text: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by **90/103/117/130/144**. When the equipper is an **Ether** character, and comes on-field or uses a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG they trigger increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.

passive.name: Lingering Cries
passive.text: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by **30/34/38/42/48**, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Kiss of Death
passive.text: When there are enemies inflicted with Attribute Anomaly on the field, the equipper's ATK increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** and they deal an additional **15/17.5/20/22.5/25%** more DMG to the target.

passive.name: Terminating Verdict
passive.text: When an **Ice attribute** equipper uses a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, their **Ice DMG** is increased by **20/23/26/29/32%** for 40s, stacking up to 2 times, once per use of a skill. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. At 2 stacks, the equipper's **Abloom** DMG dealt is increased by an additional **35/38.5/42/45.5/50%**.

passive.name: Silver Spiked Feathers
passive.text: Increases Anomaly Buildup Rate by **40/46/52/58/64%**. When the equipper deals **Ether DMG**, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by **20/23/26/29/32** for 5s, stacking up to 6 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Data Flood
passive.text:
Increases ATK by **12/15/18/21/24%**.
When using a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by **25/31/37/43/50** for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Collision Potential
passive.text:
When **EX Special Attack** hits an enemy, one of three possible effects is randomly triggered for 5 seconds. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. The same types of effects cannot stack. Repeated triggers reset the duration, allowing several effects to be active at once:
Increases the equipper's ATK by **8/9.2/10.4/11.6/12.8%**, increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by **40/46/52/58/64**, or increases the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate by **25/28/32/36/40%**.

skillPriority: Basic Attack > Chain Attack > Assist > Special Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Sever Life
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to 4 attacks forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
The 3rd and 4th Basic Attacks are considered Combustion Attacks.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Purifying Flame
entries.text:
With enough Pyre, consume 90 Pyre and hold Basic Attack to activate:
Phoenix throws her weapon, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies in an area ahead.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by **Ice Anomaly**, **Ether Anomaly**, **Electric Anomaly**, **Fire Anomaly**, **Physical Anomaly**, or **Wind Anomaly**, it triggers 1 instance of **Abloom**, dealing Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute with a **445%** multiplier.
When this instance of **Abloom** triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Meltdown
entries.text:
If Special Attack: Fire Sweep does not trigger a Perfect Block, press Basic Attack to activate:
Charges forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
During this skill, press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Dodge: Drifting Sway
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Lunge
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Dashes forward and slashes, dealing **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Twin Passage of Karmic Fire
entries.text:
After triggering a **Perfect Dodge**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Dashes forward and unleashes a quick slash, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Emergency Aid
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Dashes forward and unleashes a quick slash, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Patient Turned Doctor
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Regeneration Therapy
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Throws her weapon at the enemy, then recalls it and performs a slash, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Special Attack: Fire Sweep
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
After retreating back, quickly launches an upward slash forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
During the retreat, DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
If attacked at the instant the upward slash begins, or if the slash hits an enemy flashing red or yellow, a Perfect Block is triggered, negating that instance of DMG. Press Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash
entries.text:
While possessing Ascension, press Special Attack to consume 1 point of Ascension and activate:
After retreating, quickly performs a powerful upward slash, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
Hold Special Attack while retreating to continue charging.
While charging, release Special Attack to perform a powerful upward slash, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
When chained into from a **Combustion Attack**, skips the retreat and immediately performs the upward slash.
DMG taken while retreating and charging is reduced by 40%.
Receiving an attack just as the upward slash begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill counts as a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Quickly spins around, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies.
Receiving an attack at the moment the spin begins or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Falling Sun
entries.text:
After using EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare, and with enough Energy, press or hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Rises into the air and throws her weapon, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies.
Gains 1 point of Ascension upon activating this skill. Up to 1 point of Ascension can be held.
Receiving an attack at the moment she starts rising or hitting an enemy flashing red or yellow triggers a Perfect Block.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Flies into the air, then dives at the enemy, consuming all of Phoenix's HP to trigger an explosion, dealing massive **Fire DMG**. Phoenix then enters the Wither state and triggers the next character's Quick Assist.
This skill is considered a Combustion Attack.
Active attacks cannot be performed while in the Wither state.
After using this skill, Soul-Searching Blaze is automatically activated after a short period. Press Basic Attack to quickly activate Soul-Searching Blaze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Soul-Searching Blaze
entries.text:
Triggered when Phoenix is in the Wither state, the next time she enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist:
Phoenix covers herself in flames, dealing **Fire DMG** to nearby enemies, and exits the Wither state. This damage is considered Ultimate DMG. She then recovers all HP consumed by **Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection**, plus an additional 10% of her Max HP.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy affected by **Ice Anomaly**, **Ether Anomaly**, **Electric Anomaly**, **Fire Anomaly**, **Physical Anomaly**, or **Wind Anomaly**, it triggers 1 instance of **Abloom**, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly at a **597%** multiplier.
When this **Abloom** effect triggers a critical hit, its CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 40%.
When Phoenix enters the field via **Chain Attack: Last-Minute Salvation** or **Ultimate: Perpetual Resurrection** while in the Wither state, the HP recovery and **Abloom** effects described above are also triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press Basic Attack to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

entries.name: Core Passive: Nirvana
entries.text:
Phoenix's Anomaly Proficiency increases by **85**.
When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy in the Sear state takes Anomaly DMG, the DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit, with a base CRIT Rate of 30% and CRIT DMG of **25%**. If Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 155, each point above this threshold increases this effect's CRIT Rate by an additional 0.7%, reaching its maximum value when Phoenix's initial Anomaly Mastery reaches 255.
Enemies in the Sear state take **Fire DMG** equal to **50%** of Phoenix's ATK every 8s. This DMG is considered EX Special Attack DMG.
During Combustion Attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and dealing DMG grants Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre.
After Combustion Attacks, press Special Attack to skip the backward retreat of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, and immediately follow up with the rising attack.
When Phoenix takes fatal DMG, she will not be defeated and leave the field. Instead, Rebirth is triggered. The next time Phoenix enters the field through a normal switch-in, Quick Assist, or Defensive Assist, she recovers HP equal to 50% of her Max HP. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 1,200s.
When Phoenix triggers a Perfect Block, she gains 5 Pyre. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
When Phoenix uses an **EX Special Attack**, she enters the **Wither and Bloom** state for 20s. Hitting an enemy with a **Combustion Attack** or reapplying this state refreshes its duration.
While in the **Wither and Bloom** state, after using **EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare**, the next **EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare** is replaced with **EX Special Attack: Falling Sun**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Krampus Ace
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Anomaly** character or shares the same faction:
Anomaly DMG against enemies in the Sear state gains 15% increased CRIT DMG.

entries.name: Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Phoenix gains 1 point of **Ascension**. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The CRIT DMG of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the **Sear** state is increased by an additional 25%.
When a **Combustion Attack** deals DMG, **Pyre** generation efficiency increases by 15%.

entries.name: Curiosity Won't Kill the Cat
entries.text:
When Phoenix applies **Burn** to an enemy, its duration is increased by 2s.
Phoenix's DMG against enemies in the **Sear** state increases by 30%.

entries.name: Scarecrow Complex
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Life's End and the Heartless Wonderland
entries.text: When the Finishing Move of **Soul-Searching Blaze** or **Basic Attack: Purifying Flame** hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers 1 additional instance of **Abloom**, resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly DMG at a fixed 600% multiplier.

entries.name: Carnival of Madness
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Notes From Confinement
entries.text:
Phoenix ignores 15% of the targets' All-Attribute RES.
When Phoenix uses **EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare**, she gains 1 point of **Ascension**.
**Abloom** effects triggered by Phoenix ignore 40% of enemy DEF.
